sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.

sources.title: blip: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview blip is an image captioning and vision-language understanding model developed by salesforce that generates natural language descriptions of images. The model combines vision transformer (ViT) encoders with a text generation decoder, available in base (ViT-B) and large (ViT-L) variants, trained on 129M image-caption pairs.
